approved_payload.content: The Lekone twins, both 52 and owners of Ekhayeni Lounge, were shot dead in their vehicle at a business premises in Bochabela, Bloemfontein, on the morning of Wednesday 21 October, according to police. Police received the complaint at about 08:51 (Free State police spokesperson Lt Col Thabo Covane, via NovaNews). A witness reportedly saw a man flee in a white hatchback. Two murder cases were opened at Mangaung Police Station. As of 24 October police had announced no motive and no arrests, and had dismissed rumours of arrests (Radio Bloem). The sources disagree on the street: NovaNews gives the corner of Mkhuhlane Road and Morakile Street and the police quote names Morakile Street; Radio Bloem gives Ramatsoele Street. The map point is a Bochabela suburb point, not the premises. Two public reports, resting on police: NovaNews, 21 October, and Radio Bloem, 24 October.
